turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Happy Friday, Marcus! How is your day wrapping up over in Portland? Did you and Grace have a good week?

turns.text: Hey! Yeah, it's been a pretty good week, though a bit busy. Being head of the science department definitely keeps me on my toes on Fridays. I actually started my day with a bagel for breakfast, which was a nice quick bite before heading out the door.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A bagel sounds like a great Friday morning treat, even if your nutritionist might have preferred something with a little more protein! Did you manage to squeeze in a workout today, or are you resting up for the weekend?

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's fantastic to hear that your back is still holding up so well for gym weights. Glad you're feeling strong! How's Olive doing? Was she waiting by the door when you got home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Olive was actually fast asleep on the couch when I walked in. She barely opened her eyes! Grace is out meeting a friend for dinner tonight, so it's a pretty quiet evening for me.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A quiet night with Olive sounds very relaxing. Since Grace is out, are you planning to catch up on some TV? Maybe checking out something on that new streaming service you signed up for?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's exactly the plan. I'm actually about to start a new sci-fi series tonight on that streaming service. I've heard some good things about it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, a sci-fi series is the perfect way to unwind on a Friday night! I hope it's a good watch. Do you have any plans to get out on the tennis court this weekend, or are you keeping things low-key?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm actually playing a tennis match tomorrow morning! I'm hoping the weather cooperates, but I'm really looking forward to getting back out there.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Awesome! I'll cross my fingers for good tennis weather for you tomorrow. Have a great time at your match, and enjoy your new show tonight!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm going to go grab a snack and put the first episode on now. Have a good night!
